raw_text: The AI-generated news anchor operation targeting India is a major escalation in synthetic media disinformation. These aren't crude deepfakes - they're using commercial avatar generation tools to create professional-looking news broadcasts. The false narratives about economic collapse and internal unrest are designed to undermine India's international standing. Server infrastructure split between Islamabad and Shenzhen suggests a collaborative operation.
